# Cerebrus Pulse

> Pay-per-call crypto market data for AI agents: multi-timeframe technical analysis, hourly funding, open
> interest, liquidation models and more for 51 Hyperliquid perpetuals. No account or API key: each call
> costs $0.01–$0.06 in USDC, paid over the x402 protocol (v2) on Base or Solana. Informational
> only, not financial advice.

## Try it free

- [Free demo](https://api.cerebruspulse.xyz/demo/BTC): `GET /demo/{coin}` returns the live /pulse analysis (1h, 4h), cached 60 s, 3 requests a minute, no wallet.
- [Coin list](https://api.cerebruspulse.xyz/coins): `GET /coins`, free.
- [Health](https://api.cerebruspulse.xyz/health): `GET /health`, free.

## How payment works

An unpaid request to a paid endpoint returns HTTP 402 with the x402 v2 terms in the base64 `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`
header. An x402 v2 client (Python `x402`, TypeScript `@x402/fetch`) signs a USDC payment and retries with the
`PAYMENT-SIGNATURE` header; the receipt comes back in `PAYMENT-RESPONSE`. The payer needs USDC only, no ETH
or SOL for gas. x402 v1 clients (`x402-fetch` 1.x, the `X-PAYMENT` header) are not accepted. A request refused
with a 4xx or failing with a 5xx is not charged.

- [x402 payments guide](https://cerebruspulse.xyz/guides/x402-payments): the flow, networks, wallets and spend caps.

## Paid endpoints

| Endpoint | Price | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| `GET /screener` | $0.06 USDC | Scan 50+ perpetuals: signal strength, RSI zone, trend, volatility, funding bias, confluence |
| `GET /pulse/{coin}` | $0.025 USDC | Multi-timeframe technical analysis, derivatives snapshot, regime and confluence |
| `GET /sentiment` | $0.01 USDC | Bucketed market sentiment label and how many sources are live |
| `GET /funding/{coin}` | $0.01 USDC | Funding rate statistics over a 1-168 hour lookback (hourly rates) |
| `GET /oi/{coin}` | $0.015 USDC | Open interest: 1h/4h/24h deltas, percentile, trend, price-OI divergence |
| `GET /spread/{coin}` | $0.015 USDC | Impact spread and uncalibrated slippage estimates at $10k-$500k |
| `GET /correlation` | $0.05 USDC | BTC-alt correlation of 1h returns (30h, 7d or 30d window) with regime |
| `GET /basis/{coin}` | $0.02 USDC | Hyperliquid perp premium to its oracle, plus oracle vs Chainlink spot |
| `GET /depeg` | $0.01 USDC | USDC peg status from the Chainlink oracle on Arbitrum |
| `GET /arb` | $0.02 USDC | Market Stress Index from cross-chain arbitrage scans |
| `GET /cex-dex/{token}` | $0.02 USDC | Coinbase vs DEX/Chainlink price divergence for one token |
| `GET /liquidations/{coin}` | $0.03 USDC | Modelled liquidation zones by leverage tier, with cascade risk |
| `GET /bundle/{coin}` | $0.05 USDC | /pulse output plus 24h funding statistics and sentiment in one call |
| `GET /demo/{coin}` | Free | Live /pulse analysis (1h, 4h), cached 60 s, 3 requests/min, no wallet |
| `GET /health` | Free | Gateway health status |
| `GET /coins` | Free | List the supported perpetuals |

Units: funding rates are per hour (Hyperliquid pays hourly); open interest is counted in contracts, not USD;
`confluence.score` is a bullish vote share from 0 to 1, not a confidence; prices are per `price_unit`
(PEPE is the 1000-token `kPEPE` market).

The bundle ($0.05) returns the /pulse output, 24-hour /funding statistics and /sentiment in one request. It costs $0.005 more than buying them separately (/pulse $0.025 + /funding $0.01 + /sentiment $0.01 = $0.045). It does not include the /spread analysis.

## Integrations

- [MCP server](https://cerebruspulse.xyz/guides/mcp-server): `uvx --from "cerebrus-pulse-mcp>=0.5.2" cerebrus-pulse-mcp` for Claude, Cursor or any MCP client; pays inside spend limits.
- [Python client](https://cerebruspulse.xyz/guides/python-client): `pip install "cerebrus-pulse[pay]>=0.4.0"`, typed methods that pay inside spend limits.
- [LangChain tools](https://cerebruspulse.xyz/guides/langchain): `pip install "langchain-cerebrus-pulse[pay]>=0.4.0"`.
- [Python with x402](https://cerebruspulse.xyz/guides/python-sdk): the raw x402 SDK (`pip install "x402[evm]" httpx eth-account`).
- [TypeScript with x402](https://cerebruspulse.xyz/guides/typescript-sdk): `npm install @x402/fetch @x402/evm viem`.
- [A2A](https://cerebruspulse.xyz/guides/a2a-agents): an A2A agent card and `message/send`; A2A names the HTTP endpoint and its x402 terms, and payment happens over HTTP.
- [ACP](https://cerebruspulse.xyz/guides/acp-agents): Virtuals Protocol jobs paid in USDC ($0.03–$2.50), delivering the same engine JSON. Paused.

## A2A skills

| Skill ID | Served by | Price (USDC) | Needs a coin | Description |
|----------|-----------|--------------|--------------|-------------|
| `confluence-analysis` | `GET /pulse/{coin}` | $0.025 | Yes | Multi-timeframe technical analysis with the confluence vote share |
| `market-screener` | `GET /screener` | $0.06 | No | Screen 50+ perpetuals by signal strength |
| `open-interest-analysis` | `GET /oi/{coin}` | $0.015 | Yes | OI deltas, percentile, trend and price-OI divergence |
| `spread-analysis` | `GET /spread/{coin}` | $0.015 | Yes | Impact spread and slippage estimates |
| `correlation-matrix` | `GET /correlation` | $0.05 | No | BTC-alt correlation matrix with regime |
| `intelligence-bundle` | `GET /bundle/{coin}` | $0.05 | Yes | Pulse, 24h funding and sentiment in one call |
| `basis-analysis` | `GET /basis/{coin}` | $0.02 | Yes | Perp premium to the Hyperliquid oracle, and oracle vs Chainlink |
| `cex-dex-divergence` | `GET /cex-dex/{token}` | $0.02 | Yes | Coinbase vs DEX/Chainlink divergence for one token |
| `collateral-health` | `GET /depeg` | $0.01 | No | USDC peg status from Chainlink |
| `liquidation-heatmap` | `GET /liquidations/{coin}` | $0.03 | Yes | Modelled liquidation zones with cascade risk |
| `market-stress` | `GET /arb` | $0.02 | No | Cross-chain arbitrage stress index |

- [OpenAPI (docs site)](https://cerebruspulse.xyz/openapi.yaml): generated from the payment routes and real engine output.
- [OpenAPI (API)](https://api.cerebruspulse.xyz/openapi.json): the gateway's own copy.
- [x402 manifest](https://api.cerebruspulse.xyz/.well-known/x402): priced endpoint catalog.
- [A2A agent card](https://api.cerebruspulse.xyz/.well-known/agent-card.json): skills and prices.
- [Full documentation](https://cerebruspulse.xyz/llms-full.txt): every docs page in one file.

AAVE, ADA, APT, ARB, ATOM, AVAX, BERA, BNB, BTC, CRV, DOGE, DOT, DYDX, EIGEN, ENA, ENS, ETH, FET, FIL, HBAR, HYPE, IMX, INJ, JUP, LDO, LINK, LTC, MATIC, MKR, MNT, NEAR, ONDO, OP, PENDLE, PEPE, POL, PYTH, RENDER, SEI, SNX, SOL, STX, SUI, TAO, TIA, TRX, UNI, WIF, WLD, XLM, XRP (51; PEPE trades as kPEPE).
